App._comment: Public base URL for ABSOLUTE links in emails (cart recovery, order confirmations, campaigns, back-in-stock) and the email logo. Points at the live Render URL while the sterlinglams.com custom domain is not yet serving. When the domain is live, switch this back to https://sterlinglams.com — or override it without a redeploy by setting the App__BaseUrl environment variable in the Render Dashboard (env vars win over this file).

Serilog._comment: Serilog reads THIS section (not Logging:LogLevel). Production only, so dev keeps full SQL for learning. Database.Command at Warning silences the per-query 'Executed DbCommand' echoes while still surfacing command failures (logged at Error). Keeps app + request logs at Information.
